notes.title: 🎉 Out Now: Sugardew Island Kickstarter
notes.content:
The wait is over! 
Sugardew Island has officially launched on Kickstarter. Don't miss your chance to be part of this heartwarming adventure from the very start. Join us now on Kickstarter and dive into the unique world of Sugardew Island.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/f5a13c2f131174a0fb6bbe8bacc3a524d4ac30b7.png

[previewyoutube=bkn-mfopmXM;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

Your cozy farm shop
Step into a charming world where your shop is the heart of the community. In this cozy game, you'll manage your own farm shop, meticulously selecting goods to sell to the adorable Forest Folk. While caring for your animals and overseeing your farm play a role, your main focus is on enhancing your shop, fulfilling orders from the Harmony Tree, and revitalizing the island. Ready to become the cornerstone of Sugardew Island's revival? Launch your farm shop adventure now and make a lasting impact!

Early Bird special
Early Bird specials are available, but they won't last forever. Secure your exclusive rewards and help bring the enchanting world of Sugardew Island to life. Join our Kickstarter for all the latest updates and insider info.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/a463110f2c0e8f33efc7f650fcf0205f97b38503.png

Are you interested? Then visit our Kickstarter Campaign and take a look at unreleased material. We look forward to your support.

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: Introducing Beastiepedia!
notes.content:
Hey Beastie trainer, 

we have a little update for you!
What did we change in the world of Beasties? 

Here we go:

 Collision problems fixed, you could jump outside the runnable area.
 AI was turned up and will make less "awkward" moves and more and more sensible attacks
 Roglow, skill "Trie Out" could be unnecessarily upgraded, that´s not  longer possible.
 Elian Quest, all characters will now return to the village after the final battle! You´re free to explore the world.


And now we proudly present our little Beastiepedia! Come over and learn more about your favorite Beastie and which skills might help you during your play through! Ideas or/and feedback? Just jump on our Discord and help us to improve!

notes.title: Beasties Vlog No. 1
notes.content:
Welcome to our first Vlog for Beasties!

We will let you know what´s going on during the developing and of course what our updates contain!
I would say, long story short let´s get started 😋

    
Beasties Vlog 1 - Watch Video
    https://cdn.loom.com/sessions/thumbnails/50927dce16c045e190935d8a5ffef403-with-play.gif  


 Lynns position during the quest "Runaway" has been adjusted to avoid players getting stuck inbetween her and the environment.
 Collision detection for NPCs has been improved.
 Unfinished locas are no longer displayed on computers with non-english or non-german language settings. Instead, English loca is now default with german currently being the only selectable alternative. 
 Fixed a bug in which players couldn't close some tutorial screens.
 Beasties that join a players' team will now be placed in your inventory and only be sent back to the village once your inventory is full. 

Feel free to join us on Discord!

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Beasties
notes.content:
You want to know more about Beasties? 

Beastie Brawls
Our turn-based puzzle combat system is easily accessible for beginners, but offers enough depth and the ability to plan moves far in advance for hardened veterans. They like to brawl our Beasties ;)

Improve your Beasties
Our friends, the Beasties, receive primordial dust plates as loot after winning battles. With them you'll improve their abilities. In this way, you can upgrade each Beastie individually by investing in health, defense, strength and special abilities. You decide how to set up your team based on your strategy!


And of course you are more than welcome to join us on Discord!
Share your feedback & Ideas directly with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40481334/ef150760706fd7b34864144892ae45f621a7bedd.png

Your team @rokaplay

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Beasties!
notes.content:
What is Beasties? 

Beasties is a lovingly 🧡 hand-drawn 2D monster trainer game with a turn-based puzzle combat, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. 

The Beasties live in complete harmony and symbiosis with humans. But this harmony gets cracked after the disappearance of a Beastiemaster. The guild of Beastiemasters sends you to an isolated village to find out what happened to the master.

Will you find the master and restore the old balance?

Go ahaead and try your luck!

Your team @rokaplay
